title: JVM internals and performance — Module Quiz
description: Course assessment: Diagnose a service whose memory use grows over time.
author: DailyCoder

questions.prompt: What makes an otherwise unused object eligible for garbage collection?

options.text: It is no longer reachable from GC roots

questions.explanation: Reachability determines retention, not whether the application intends to use it.

questions.prompt: Can a reachable, unbounded cache cause a Java memory leak?
questions.explanation: GC cannot reclaim objects that are still retained.

questions.prompt: Which tool is appropriate for JVM event recordings?
questions.explanation: Java Flight Recorder captures runtime events for diagnosis.

questions.prompt: Which framework is designed for Java microbenchmarks?
questions.explanation: JMH helps manage JVM-specific benchmarking hazards.
It is a request and does not establish a collection schedule.

questions.prompt: Why can cold single-run timings mislead?

options.text: The wall clock is always constant
JIT compilation and warm-up change execution
